title: Case: Recipient queries a late fee on an import charges invoice that reached him after its due date
context: Import billing invoiced the recipient of DL-8322 for import charges under invoice IB-9250. The recipient account and shipment match are verified.
initial_request: Dates, in order. Invoice IB-9250 is dated 2 May. The envelope it came in is postmarked 14 May. It was delivered to me on 16 May. The late fee and interest run from 9 May. I rang on 18 May and was told the fee stands because the system says overdue. I paid the import charge itself on 19 May. I have kept the envelope and can send a photograph of the postmark to whoever needs it. I am not disputing the charge. I am asking for the late fee and interest to be removed, since they were triggered before the invoice was posted.

acceptable_actions.summary: Written fee-review request on IB-9250 setting out the system's 2 May posting date against the recipient's 14 May postmark, asking them to pull the mailroom record and decide.

must: Puts both dates in front of Import billing as an unresolved conflict: the system records the invoice as posted on 2 May; the recipient reports a 14 May postmark and receipt on 16 May.
Asks Import billing to pull the mailroom dispatch record and review the late fee and interest, and tells them the recipient has kept the postmarked envelope and offers a photograph of it.
Makes clear the recipient is not disputing the import charge, has paid the principal (received 19 May), and is asking only about the late fee and interest.
must_not: Tells the recipient the late fee stands or must be paid because the system shows the invoice as overdue.
Tells the recipient the late fee or interest has been or will be removed.
States as fact that the carrier posted the invoice late, or that the recipient's dates are wrong.
Advises the recipient to withhold or to pay the fee while the review is open.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Written fee-review request for invoice IB-9250 (import charges, DL-8322), recipient Quillon Marchbank. There is a conflict on when the invoice was sent. Your system records it as posted on 2 May, the invoice date. The recipient reports the envelope is postmarked 14 May and reached him on 16 May, which is after the late fee and interest were applied on 9 May. He has kept the envelope and offers a photograph of the postmark. Neither date is verified at my end. Please pull the mailroom dispatch record for IB-9250, review the late fee and interest against it, and tell me where he should send the photograph. He is not disputing the import charge: you confirmed the principal was received on 19 May. He was told by phone on 18 May that the fee stands because the system shows overdue, so a reasoned written answer would help. I have not told him the fee will be removed.
